verses.text: Of David. You should not fret over those doing evil, and do not be jealous of the workers of iniquity.

segments.text: Of David. You should not fret over those doing evil, and do not be jealous of the workers of iniquity.

verses.text: For like the grass, soon they are cut off, and like the green of the herb they shall wither.

segments.text: For like the grass, soon they are cut off, and like the green of the herb they shall wither.

verses.text: Trust in YHWH and do good; dwell in the land and graze in faithfulness.

segments.text: Trust in YHWH and do good; dwell in the land and graze in faithfulness.

verses.text: And delight yourself in YHWH, and He will give to you the desires of your heart.

segments.text: And delight yourself in YHWH, and He will give to you the desires of your heart.

verses.text: Roll upon YHWH your way; trust in Him, and He will act.

segments.text: Roll upon YHWH your way; trust in Him, and He will act.

verses.text: And He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, and your justice like the noonday sun.

segments.text: And He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, and your justice like the noonday sun.

verses.text: Be still before YHWH, and wait patiently for Him; do not fret over the one succeeding in his path, over the man making schemes.

segments.text: Be still before YHWH, and wait patiently for Him; do not fret over the one succeeding in his path, over the man making schemes.

verses.text: Cease from anger, and leave [behind] wrath; you should not burn—[it] only causes harm.

segments.text: Cease from anger, and leave [behind] wrath; you should not burn—[it] only causes harm.

verses.text: For those doing evil will be cut off, and those waiting on YHWH, they will inherit the land.

segments.text: For those doing evil will be cut off, and those waiting on YHWH, they will inherit the land.

verses.text: And in yet a little while, the wicked man [is] no more; and you will look for his place, and it [is] no more.

segments.text: And in yet a little while, the wicked man [is] no more; and you will look for his place, and it [is] no more.

verses.text: And the meek will inherit the land, and they will delight in the abundance of peace.

segments.text: And the meek will inherit the land, and they will delight in the abundance of peace.

verses.text: The wicked man is plotting against the righteous one and is gnashing his teeth at him.

segments.text: The wicked man is plotting against the righteous one and is gnashing his teeth at him.

verses.text: The Lord laughs at him, for He sees that his day is coming.

segments.text: The Lord laughs at him, for He sees that his day is coming.

verses.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword and have bent their bows, to cast down the poor and needy, [and] to slay those upright in the path.

segments.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword and have bent their bows, to cast down the poor and needy, [and] to slay those upright in the path.

verses.text: Their sword will come [into] their own heart, and their bows will be broken.

segments.text: Their sword will come [into] their own heart, and their bows will be broken.

verses.text: Better [is] the little of the righteous, than the riches of many wicked.

segments.text: Better [is] the little of the righteous, than the riches of many wicked.

verses.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, and YHWH upholds the righteous.

segments.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, and YHWH upholds the righteous.

verses.text: YHWH Knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will be forever.

segments.text: YHWH Knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will be forever.

verses.text: They will not be ashamed in a time of evil, and in days of famine they will be satisfied.

segments.text: They will not be ashamed in a time of evil, and in days of famine they will be satisfied.

verses.text: But the wicked will perish, and the enemies of YHWH; like the splendor of the meadows they will be consumed, [and] with the smoke they will be consumed.

segments.text: But the wicked will perish, and the enemies of YHWH; like the splendor of the meadows they will be consumed, [and] with the smoke they will be consumed.

verses.text: The wicked borrows and does not repay, and the righteous one is gracious and giving.

segments.text: The wicked borrows and does not repay, and the righteous one is gracious and giving.

verses.text: For those being blessed by Him will inherit the land, and those being cursed by Him will be cut off.

segments.text: For those being blessed by Him will inherit the land, and those being cursed by Him will be cut off.

verses.text: By YHWH the steps of a man are established, and in his way He delights.

segments.text: By YHWH the steps of a man are established, and in his way He delights.

verses.text: Though he falls, he will not be cast down, for YHWH is upholding his hand.

segments.text: Though he falls, he will not be cast down, for YHWH is upholding his hand.

verses.text: I have been young, and I am old; and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, and his seed seeking bread.

segments.text: I have been young, and I am old; and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, and his seed seeking bread.

verses.text: All the day, he is gracious and lending, and his seed are a blessing.

segments.text: All the day, he is gracious and lending, and his seed are a blessing.

verses.text: Turn away from evil and do good, and you will dwell forever.

segments.text: Turn away from evil and do good, and you will dwell forever.

verses.text: For YHWH loves justice, and He will not forsake His holy ones; forever they are preserved, and the seed of the wicked will be cut off.

segments.text: For YHWH loves justice, and He will not forsake His holy ones; forever they are preserved, and the seed of the wicked will be cut off.

verses.text: The righteous will inherit the land, and they will dwell forever in it.

segments.text: The righteous will inherit the land, and they will dwell forever in it.

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

segments.text: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

verses.text: The law of his God [is] in his heart; his steps do not slip.

segments.text: The law of his God [is] in his heart; his steps do not slip.

verses.text: The wicked is keeping watch on the righteous, and he is seeking to kill him.

segments.text: The wicked is keeping watch on the righteous, and he is seeking to kill him.

verses.text: YHWH will not leave him in his hand, and will not declare him wicked in his being judged.

segments.text: YHWH will not leave him in his hand, and will not declare him wicked in his being judged.

verses.text: Wait on YHWH and keep His way, and He will exalt you [so as] to possess the land; in the cutting off [of] the wicked, you will see [it].

segments.text: Wait on YHWH and keep His way, and He will exalt you [so as] to possess the land; in the cutting off [of] the wicked, you will see [it].

verses.text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless one spread out like a luxuriant native tree.

segments.text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless one spread out like a luxuriant native tree.

verses.text: And he passed away, and behold, he was no more; and indeed I sought him, and he could not be found.

segments.text: And he passed away, and behold, he was no more; and indeed I sought him, and he could not be found.

verses.text: Observe a blameless one, and see an upright one, for the end of the man [is] well-being.

verses.text: But those transgressing will be destroyed together; the end for the wicked man is cut off.

segments.text: But those transgressing will be destroyed together; the end for the wicked man is cut off.

verses.text: And the salvation of the righteous [is] from YHWH; He [is] their stronghold in time of distress.

verses.text: And YHWH helps them and rescues them; He shall rescue them from the wicked and save them, because they have taken refuge in Him.
